Generic history object = properties common to all history types (Float history table on 7.4: clock, itemid, ns, value). value type differs per history type: float (Float history), integer (Integer history), string (String history), text (Text, Log, Binary, JSON history). Text history and Log history additionally have "id" (ID of the history entry); Log history additionally has logeventid (integer), severity (integer), source (string), timestamp (timestamp). Binary history section exists on 7.0+ pages, JSON history section on 8.0 page. Page sections 5.0-6.4: Float, Integer, String, Text, Log.
